task.title: Take a photo of a document
task.shortdesc: Photograph a page with the camera, straighten it, describe it and attach it to a person.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how. Put the page on a plain, well lit surface.

stepresult.p: The first time, Android asks if the app may take pictures and record video. Your choices are While using the app, Only this time and Don't allow.

info.p: If you choose Don't allow, the app says that the camera permission is needed to photograph a document. Choose , then choose again to be asked again.

stepresult.p: The camera opens. It has buttons for the flash and for the other camera.
A screen named opens. It asks you to drag the corners to the edges of the document.

step.cmd: Drag the corners to the edges of the page, then choose .

info.p: Use to turn the picture and to start again.

step.cmd: Type a short description of the picture, then choose .

info.p: The description is needed. It lets a person who cannot see the picture know what it shows.

stepresult.p: A card for the picture shows under .

result.p: The app keeps the picture in a folder beside your tree. Never photograph a page with private details in it, and say in the description where the page came from. You can take the permission away again in the settings of your .
says how to view, copy or remove a picture.
